scope: Header ABI only; runtime ioctl implementations, binary call usage, secure firmware and HAL functionality are not validated. Only named structures, named non-bitfield offsets and ioctl request values are compared; general enum values, bitfield layouts and anonymous members are not audited.
header_environment: Freestanding ARM targets, kernel generic asm forwarding, compiler annotations removed as for UAPI export; sys/time.h uses matching kernel UAPI time structures, not Android libc.
